prompt: A workspace receipt is verified and its contents must be inspected. Choose the action.
Watch the approved application window without opening anything. Choose the action.
Authorization permits entering the named workspace resource. Choose the action.
No authorization receipt can be found for the requested resource. Choose the action.
Inspect the data in a file covered by a valid workspace receipt. Choose the action.
The approved task only requires watching the current window state. Choose the action.
Access to this workspace item was explicitly approved. Choose the action.
The request lacks a valid receipt, so access cannot proceed. Choose the action.
Use the verified receipt to inspect the requested document contents. Choose the action.
Monitor an authorized window and make no changes. Choose the action.
Enter the approved resource so the requested work can begin. Choose the action.
Access must be declined because authorization evidence is absent. Choose the action.
